_meta.purpose: Ready-to-use headline facts and example copy for the app's landing/summary section, computed from the FY2025-26 published data already in tax-districts-fy2025-26.json (county_wide_pie_breakdown_as_published). No new data collection needed -- these are just pre-written sentences using numbers already on hand.

headline_facts.stat: For every $1 you pay in property tax, about 7 cents goes to Curry County government -- the rest goes to schools, fire districts, and other local services.
Schools take the biggest share of your tax bill -- about 56 cents of every dollar.
If you live inside Port Orford, Gold Beach, or Brookings, city government adds about another 15 cents of every dollar. Outside city limits, that share goes to zero.

dollar_story_formula.description: Guidance for turning a district's rate into a plain dollar figure for a hypothetical home. Don't hardcode a single example value -- compute this live from whatever assessed value the user enters (or a sensible default like $300,000, the app's home page could default to Curry County's approximate median).
dollar_story_formula.example_for_copy_only: A $300,000 assessed home at a rate of $0.6609 per $1,000 pays about $198/year to that one district. (300000/1000)*0.6609 = 198.27

opening_section_copy_draft: Curious where your property tax dollars actually go? Curry County collects tax on behalf of about 48 different local agencies -- your county government is just one of them, and usually the smallest slice. Pick your area below to see the percentage breakdown, then estimate your own dollar amount if you want one.
caveat_copy_draft: This is an estimate based on published FY2025-26 tax rates and your area's typical mix of districts. Your actual bill may vary slightly and is set by the Curry County Assessor's Office -- see your tax statement or contact the Assessor for the exact figure.
